source.byte_hash_verification: Fetched bytes independently matched both evidence-manifest SHA256 and byte lengths.

method.query_statistics: Exact frozen summary values retained, percentages independently recomputed; raw row/ledger replay is the separate artifact audit.
method.resource_statistics: Medians of exactly four workers per side/cohort; all individual values retained. Delta is candidate minus baseline; positive reduction means faster/smaller.
method.ingestion_statistics: Primary percentage compares the sum of all four paired batch wall times, not the ratio of medians; medians and every round are separately retained.
method.cpu: Only process snapshot metrics are derived here; MCP per-call calling-process CPU belongs to the client and is not reported as server CPU.
method.scope: One hosted AMD EPYC/CPython 3.12.16 experiment, existing regression cohorts, no generated answers or new quality claims.

disposition.reason: Unchanged reingestion regresses in every paired round in both cohorts; the implementation remains under refinement despite pooled query improvements.
disposition.future_refinement: Any follow-up must be a separate registered experiment; this source summary and protocol3 remain immutable.
